raw_collection.snapshot_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 concatenation of sorted relative_path + NUL + byte_size + NUL + uppercase_file_sha256 + LF for every file under raw_collection.root

metric_definitions.policy_loss: terminal_result is 0 or 1 and does not equal seat
metric_definitions.eligible_divergence: ppo_row and final_action differs from teacher_action
metric_definitions.protected_ppo_row: decision.protected is true and decision.ppo_eligible is true
metric_definitions.protected_action_divergence: decision.protected is true and final_action differs from teacher_action
metric_definitions.zero_residual_eligible_argmax_divergence: ppo_row and neural_shadow_action differs from teacher_action
metric_definitions.paired_win_delta: stochastic policy_win minus deterministic control candidate_win on the exact identity key

required_recomputations: verify every input hash and the rollout snapshot hash
run the checked no-game manifest dataset validator
verify exact schedule coverage and unique identity keys
verify all retained and A/B audit receipts, terminal results, engine steps, schemas, and runtime receipts
count model failures, timeouts, action errors, exceptions, max-step hits, and duplicate mismatches
compute wins, losses, draws, PPO rows, eligible divergences, protected violations, and zero-residual argmax violations overall, by seat, by opponent, and by opponent-seat cell
join the deterministic control on the exact identity key and compute paired win deltas
report Wilson 95 percent intervals for overall win rate and overall eligible-divergence rate
evaluate every gate without running PPO
decision_scope: Numerically assess collection admissibility and PPO-start readiness only. Do not train, package, submit, or make a strength/promotion claim.
